picks.analysis: HOOD scores +5.9 — a Call recommendation. The bullish read is led by Technicals (+2.1), reinforced by Mechanicals (+2). The biggest contributors are Unusual Volume (+1.2, 1.67x hrly), MACD (+1, 0.61), MA Stack (20/50/100D) (+1, 3/3 above). Cutting the other way: Put/Call Ratio Extreme (-0.4, 0.23 P/C), P/E vs Sector (-0.3, 44.6). Within Capital Markets we gave HOOD a +5.9 and SCHW a +5.4 — same direction, lower conviction — which is why we'd take HOOD calls over SCHW calls, mainly on Technicals (+2.1 vs +1.2) and Mechanicals (+2 vs +1.2). The suggested calls sit ~2.0% from spot with 35d to expiry, delta 0.59, mid $7.75 — a near-the-money Δ 0.45-0.65 contract (survives noise) inside the premium (≤ the larger of $35 or 12% of spot) / standard-monthly criteria.
